name: Haruharo!
source:
Momotei Gakuen is a co-educational boarding school with a male-to-female ratio of 1:10. It was an all-girls school when it was founded - however, the rights of the girls traditionally outweigh those of the boys.
They are housed in a boarded, rundown dormitory, which is a far cry from the luxurious girls' dormitory.

The "March 3rd Committee" plays a major role in their ill-treatment.

This all-girls committee, the most powerful in the school, is the key to this female chauvinism. They hold positions that resemble those of a podium, and are the object of admiration amongst the female students.
One day, a rumor was circulated that the boys' dormitory was to be closed. Eventually, they learn that it is not a rumor but a fact, and the boys finally stand up for themselves.
They (forcibly) form the "Private Peach Youth Student Council" with the protagonist, Kaoru Kuze, as its president.

Thus begins the resistance of the private student council to regain the boys' basic student rights!

[Translated from [url=http://www.propeller-game.com/m/pro/haruharo/story.html/]the official website.[/url]]
translation:
桃亭学园是一所男女同校的寄宿制学校，男女比例为1比10。学校创办之初是一所女校，因此传统上女生的权利远高于男生。
男生们被安置在一栋用木板修补、破败不堪的宿舍里，与豪华的女生宿舍有着天壤之别。

“三月三日委员会”在男生遭受的不公待遇中扮演着重要角色。

这个全由女生组成的委员会是校内权力最大的组织，也是女尊风气的核心。委员会成员身居如同站在讲台之上的高位，深受女学生们仰慕。
一天，校园里传出男生宿舍即将关闭的消息。后来，男生们得知这并非谣言，而是既定事实，于是终于决定奋起抗争。
他们以主人公久世薰为会长，（强行）组建了“私立桃色青年学生会”。

为了夺回男生最基本的学生权利，私人学生会的反抗就此开始！

[翻译自[url=http://www.propeller-game.com/m/pro/haruharo/story.html/]官方网站。[/url]]
